description: This file defines a React functional component 'GuardrailInfoView' that displays and manages guardrail information, including viewing, editing, and updating configurations related to guardrails in a UI. It involves state management, API calls for fetching and updating guardrail data, and rendering various UI elements and forms for interaction.

methods.name: fetchGuardrailInfo
methods.description: Fetches guardrail info from backend and initializes various state variables with the retrieved data, including PII configuration.

methods.name: fetchGuardrailProviderSpecificParams
methods.description: Fetches provider-specific parameters for guardrails from backend.

methods.name: fetchGuardrailUISettings
methods.description: Fetches UI settings related to guardrails.

methods.name: resetToolPermissionEditor
methods.description: Resets the tool permission configuration state based on existing guardrail data.

methods.name: handleToolPermissionConfigChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the tool permission configuration.

methods.name: handlePiiEntitySelect
methods.description: Handles selection toggling of PII entities.

methods.name: handlePiiActionSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of actions for a specific PII entity.

methods.name: handleGuardrailUpdate
methods.description: Aggregates and sends updated guardrail configuration to the backend API for persistence.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date string into a human-readable locale string.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to clipboard and manages UI feedback for success.
